message: As a parent, it's all about balancing safety and freedom for our kids, right? I recently found a resource from the U.S. Fire Administration that dives into home fire safety — a must-read for anyone with little ones running around. 🏠 It’s packed with practical tips that can help us keep our homes safe while giving our kids the space to explore. Remember, a little knowledge goes a long way in creating a cozy, safe environment for everyone!
